name: windrose-md
description: Interactive dungeon and world mapping plugin for Obsidian

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.deploy: bun run build:dev && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='C:/Users/whipl/OneDrive/Documents/Absalom/.obsidian/plugins/windrose-map-designer';['main.js','styles.css','manifest.json'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,d+'/'+f));console.log('Deployed to vault')"

//dependencies: ajv, brace-expansion, minimatch, and picomatch are NOT imported by src/ — they are direct-dependency security pins forcing the resolver onto patched versions for the Obsidian store dependency scan (see //overrides). Do not prune them as unused. fflate is the only genuinely imported runtime dependency here besides preact (pinned in devDependencies).
//overrides: Security pins for transitive dev/test tooling flagged by the Obsidian store dependency scan. None of these ship in main.js (esbuild externalizes obsidian/electron/codemirror; the mermaid subtree comes from obsidian-typings for type annotations only and is never imported at runtime). preact is the sole runtime-bundled package and is pinned separately in devDependencies.
